title.narrative: Strengthening the Power of Youth Voices Quarterly Progress Report: January 2026 – March 2026

description.narrative: During this reporting period, the two implementing organizations collectively reached 687,594 participants (684,319 online, 3,275 offline), engaged 43 duty bearers, and addressed 5 concrete governance challenges at the community level. CMD-Kenya implemented a total of 21 activities comprising community dialogue forums, intergenerational dialogues, and party branch building workshops across the six project counties. Siasa Place ran 3 community agenda-setting dialogues, 2 regional tertiary student leader forums, and a mentorship and exchange session for youth and CBO leaders. Key highlights of the quarter include: • CMD-Kenya convened the 8th annual People Dialogue Festival (PDF) (4–7 March 2026) at Uhuru Park, Nairobi, with an average daily attendance of over 4,000 participants. • Siasa Place facilitated the registration of 1,309 new voters through community and tertiary-level forums. • 5 governance challenges were successfully resolved: construction of 2 new classrooms at Nzoani Secondary School (Kitui), completion of the Tuffgone culvert (Nairobi/Kibra), repair of Bukhori village borehole (Busia), completion of Kanziko Health Centre maternity wing (Kitui), and waste collection at Port Victoria market (Busia). • CMD-Kenya supported the United Party of Independent Alliance (UPIA) to successfully transition from its old party constitution to a new, inclusively structured constitution, with youth playing a central role in the revision process. • 15 community conversation starters and 45 CBO representatives received new training in advocacy and social media accountability.
